role: ReconciliationManager: duplicate-collection guard (sessionExists, true when the archive holds the session id) used by device recording. Built once at launch with the collector, it removes the Documents/HRVOffline folder (pending.json, whole sessions in plain JSON) that older builds kept for an offline sync queue nothing drained.
types: ReconciliationManager: class — duplicate guard; removes the retired HRVOffline queue
state: file:Documents/HRVOffline/ (retired offline queue from older builds, pending.json; removed at launch, never written)
toplevel: Stored property: archive (SessionArchive). Owned by RRCollector (RRCollector.swift).

units.does: Stores the archive and, when the Documents URL resolves, removes the retired offline queue there (removeRetiredOfflineQueue).
units.entry: Called once at launch by RRCollector's init (no reconciliation injected), and by tests.

branches.effect: true: removeRetiredOfflineQueue(in: documents); false: nothing removed

units.does: True when the archive already has the session id (SessionArchive.exists).

Removes <documents>/HRVOffline, the folder where older builds kept an offline sync queue (pending.json, whole sessions as plain JSON) that nothing read or drained, logging the removal. No folder: returns without doing anything. A failed removal is logged as a warning and tried again at the next launch.
units.entry: Called by init ReconciliationManager(archive:) with Documents; ReconciliationManagerTests call it on a temporary folder.

branches.effect: logged as a warning; retried next launch
